slug: 2024-11-22 Eswatini unveils readiness report for digital ID, transformation push

SWZ.note: Only a plan to develop a national digital identity system is stated; no authentication service.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.
The 88 percent is a share of adults over 15 from a survey, not enrolment over the whole population.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates the ID system.
Nothing on registers keyed on the ID number.
Only an initiative to develop a national digital identity system is stated, not procured, being built or piloted.
